blurbs.Allied_Carrier_Doctrine_Reorganised: Allied naval command overhauls carrier task force doctrine, drawing on lessons from the war's early island-hopping campaigns.
blurbs.Allied_Landings_on_Kyushu: Allied forces begin a bloody, grinding invasion of the Japanese home islands.
blurbs.Allied_Occupation_of_Japan: The US, UK, France, and China establish a joint administration over defeated Japan.
blurbs.Armistice_of_London: The new German government signs an armistice with Britain and France; Czechoslovakia comes out of the war with only minor border adjustments.
blurbs.ASAT_Moratorium_Collapses: An informal ban on anti-satellite weapons testing breaks down amid renewed bloc tension, the last guardrail before disaster.
blurbs.ASAT_Strike_Blinds_a_Constellation: A live anti-satellite strike knocks out a rival's reconnaissance constellation, framed at first as bloodless and deniable.
blurbs.Atlantic-Continental_Alliance_Formalised: The wartime US-UK-French-German alliance hardens into a permanent collective defence structure.
blurbs.Attack_on_Pearl_Harbor: Japan strikes the US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor, drawing America into open war in the Pacific.
blurbs.Autonomous_Interception_Ban_Enters_Force: A wartime treaty formally bans fully autonomous weapons interception, reinforcing human-in-the-loop doctrine even in the new mech era.
blurbs.Battle_of_Midway: The US Navy breaks Japanese naval codes and wins a decisive carrier battle, blunting Japan's Pacific offensive.
blurbs.Battle_of_Tarawa: A brutal amphibious assault on the fortified atoll becomes a costly proving ground for Pacific island-hopping tactics.
blurbs.Battle_of_the_Mekong_Corridor: Heavy fighting along the Mekong marks the war's shift from colonial counterinsurgency to conventional great-power confrontation.
blurbs.Battle_of_the_Philippine_Sea: A massive Allied carrier fleet shatters Japanese naval airpower in one of the war's largest engagements.
blurbs.Belt_Extraction_Begins_Ungoverned: Serious extraction infrastructure goes up across the Belt with essentially no state administration, per the new postwar doctrine.
blurbs.Belt_Labour_Disputes_Resolved_by_Force: With no state willing to intervene this far out, operator-versus-worker disputes start settling by whichever side has the better security force.
blurbs.Belt_Navigation_Beacons_Go_Online: A basic navigation beacon network goes up across the Belt—essential infrastructure ahead of the extraction rush.
blurbs.Berlin_Coup: German military leaders remove Hitler and the bulk of the Nazi leadership from power.
blurbs.Berlin_Transit_Crisis_Ends_in_Negotiatio: A dispute over transit rights through Germany settles at the table rather than escalating, an early test of the still-fragile peace.
blurbs.Blockade_of_the_Home_Islands: Allied naval forces tighten a strangling blockade around Japan, cutting off food and matériel imports.
blurbs.Aden_Protectorate_Crisis: Unrest against British administration in the Aden Protectorate boils over into a tense standoff, testing Britain's postwar regional grip.
blurbs.Britain_and_France_Declare_War: London and Paris honour their commitments to Czechoslovakia and declare war on Germany.
blurbs.Britain_Drawn_In_by_Treaty: Treaty obligations pull Britain into the widening war alongside France.
blurbs.British_Pacific_Bases_Reopened: Britain reactivates mothballed Pacific bases to support the widening war effort.
blurbs.Burma_Declares_Armed_Neutrality: Burma opts out of the widening war, arming itself to deter incursions from either side.
blurbs.Callisto_Accords_Standardise_Free-Port_L: A treaty at Callisto standardises free-port law across the Jovian system, formalising its role as neutral ground.
blurbs.Callisto_Becomes_a_Neutral_Free_Port: With the lowest radiation exposure of the major moons, Callisto becomes the Jovian system's neutral trading hub.
blurbs.Carbon_Nanotube_Production_Becomes_Comme: Ultra-high-strength cable materials move from academic curiosity to commercial-scale production, unlocking real elevator engineering.
blurbs.Caribbean_Fleet_Standoff: A Soviet naval and troop buildup near Cuba brings US and Soviet forces into a tense, prolonged standoff with no clear diplomatic off-ramp.
blurbs.Ceasefire_Border_Commission_Established: A joint commission is set up to finalise contested borders left unresolved by the ceasefire.
blurbs.Chartered_Companies_Become_Standard_Prac: The chartered-operator model spreads from elevators to lunar and cislunar infrastructure across every major bloc.
blurbs.Chartered_Operating_Companies_Introduced: Governments begin handing day-to-day elevator operations to state-chartered quasi-private companies, a consequential administrative shift.
blurbs.China_Announces_Indonesian_Counterweight: China unveils plans for its own elevator, partnered with a newly independent Southeast Asian archipelago state.
blurbs.China_Secures_Elevator_Site_in_Indonesia: China finalises its own equatorial basing agreement, though its programme lags the other four technically.
blurbs.Chinese_and_Soviet_Escalation_in_Indochi: Chinese and Soviet material support to Vietnamese independence forces escalates past proxy involvement, tipping France's colonial war toward a wider conflict.
blurbs.Chinese_Communist_Revolution: China's civil war ends in Communist victory, won without major outside military intervention and on harder terms than the Party had hoped.
blurbs.Cislunar_Navigation_Standard_Adopted: A shared navigation and traffic-control standard is adopted as cislunar space grows increasingly crowded.
blurbs.Civil_Rights_Movement: The American civil rights movement presses forward through legislative fights and mass organising, unburdened by any overseas draft war dragging at public attention.
blurbs.Closed-Loop_Life_Support_Trials: Multi-year closed-loop life support trials begin, tackling the hardest unsolved problem standing between the Moon and Mars.
blurbs.CNT-FAI_Tensions_Within_Spain: Friction grows between Spain's consolidating state-socialist government and its anarchist-descended CNT-FAI factions who never fully signed on to central authority.
blurbs.Cold_War_Brinkmanship: Without threats sufficient to force restraint, great-power crises play out through sheer conventional brinkmanship.
blurbs.Collapse_of_Kessler_Extraction: Kessler Extraction collapses outright, its claims and survey data absorbed piecemeal by LIN Opticene—the Belt's cautionary tale.
blurbs.Collapse_of_the_Japanese_Government: Under the compounding weight of blockade, bombing, and invasion, Japan's government collapses and seeks surrender.
blurbs.Commercial_Lunar_Water_Extraction_Begins: Chartered operators begin the first commercially viable extraction of lunar water ice.
blurbs.Commercial_Satellite_Repair_Consortium_F: A chartered consortium forms to service ageing orbital assets, an early sign of infrastructure work drifting toward private operators.
blurbs.Compact_Adopts_Permanent_Lunar_Presence_: The Compact commits to a long-term lunar presence rather than a one-off landing, reframing the race as an infrastructure contest.
blurbs.Compact_Crewed_Landing_on_Mars: The Compact's own crewed Mars landing closes out the three-way race for a second time.
blurbs.Compact_Ministers_Approve_Joint_Launch_V: British, French, and German ministers sign off on a shared heavy launch vehicle after years of consensus-building.
blurbs.Compact_Orbital_Tug_Programme_Announced: The Compact announces a fleet of orbital tugs to support elevator-fed cislunar logistics.
blurbs.Compact_Secures_Elevator_Site_in_Gabon: The Compact negotiates an independence-plus-partnership basing deal in its former Central African territory.
blurbs.Congo_Elevator_Becomes_Earths_Most_Defen: Understanding exactly how close it came to sharing its neighbour's fate, Earth turns the Congo elevator into its most heavily defended piece of infrastructure.
blurbs.Continental_Rocket_Testing_Accord: Major powers agree to limit high-yield rocket and reactor testing in shared corridors, an early and partial step toward arms control.
blurbs.Contract_Labour_Becomes_Standard_on_Mars: Multi-year contract labour becomes the norm for Mars infrastructure work, first through the US chartered-operator model and then spreading elsewhere.
blurbs.Cuban_Revolution: A Soviet-aligned revolutionary government takes power in Cuba, aligning the island firmly with Moscow.
blurbs.CzechGerman_Armistice_Front_Stabilises: Fighting along the Czech border quiets as both sides await the outcome of Berlin's negotiations with the Allies.
blurbs.Czechoslovak_General_Mobilisation_Plans_: Prague revises its mobilisation timetable as German pressure over the Sudetenland intensifies.
blurbs.Daughter_Colonies_Push_Outward: Third-generation daughter colonies of the Free Belt Company and Soviet collective push into the outer system, following opportunity as they always have.
blurbs.Deep-Space_Relay_Chain_Completed: A relay network extending communications support out to Mars distances comes fully online.
blurbs.Destruction_of_the_Ecuador_Space_Elevato: A years-planned hybrid sabotage-and-kinetic strike brings down the US elevator, the war's single most shocking act.
blurbs.Destruction_of_the_Gabon_Space_Elevator: Weeks later, the Compact's Gabon elevator falls the same way, confirming the strikes are a systematic campaign, not an isolated incident.
blurbs.Earth-Mars_Communications_Cut_for_Eleven: A deliberate or accidental relay outage leaves Earth blind to events on Mars for nearly half a day.
blurbs.Earth-Mars_Communications_Treaty_Signed: Exhausted combatants agree on protected communications channels as informal peace talks begin in earnest.
blurbs.EarthMoon_Freight_Tariff_Convention: Major blocs agree on a shared tariff framework for the fast-growing cislunar freight economy.
blurbs.Earths_Wealthy_Buy_Mars_Property: Wealthy Earth transplants begin acquiring comfortable Mars habitats as second homes, the first step toward the paradise-retreat future.
blurbs.Earth_Banks_Begin_Taking_Jovian_Resource: Earth's financial institutions begin accepting Jovian resource futures as loan collateral, a quiet marker of how dependent Earth's economy has become.
blurbs.Earth_Blockades_Belt_Shipping_Lanes: Earth attempts to force the issue by blockading Belt shipping lanes by force, the real if undeclared start of the war.
blurbs.Earth_Capitulates: Realising a replacement elevator is now physically near-impossible to build, Earth capitulates rather than risk losing another.
blurbs.Earth_Commodity_Markets_Crash_on_Jovian_: Rumours of a Jovian supply disruption send Earth commodity markets into a panic, exposing how fragile the dependency has become.
blurbs.Earth_Grants_Off-World_Autonomy: Earth formally grants chartered operators independent governing authority over their settlements, having proven direct control from this distance doesn't work.
blurbs.Earth_Grows_Dependent_on_Belt_Resources: Earth's stagnating industrial base becomes dependent on Belt and Jovian resource exports it can no longer easily replicate at home.
blurbs.Earth_Lifts_First_Selective_Sanctions: Earth blocs lift a first round of trade sanctions against the Jovian majors, a brief and ultimately failed easing of tensions.
blurbs.Earth_Recognises_Jovian_Sovereignty: Peace terms formally recognise the Big Four and the Jovian Coalition as sovereign peers, not revocable chartered subjects.
blurbs.Earth_Reconstruction_Bonds_Issued: Earth blocs issue reconstruction bonds to fund recovery from the war and the loss of two elevators.
blurbs.Ecuador_Security_Zone_Declared: The US declares a protected security perimeter around the Ecuador elevator construction site.
blurbs.Elevator_Materials_Science_Funded: Multiple blocs commit serious institutional funding to elevator engineering for the first time.
blurbs.Emergency_Ceasefire: Horror at the first nuclear strike forces a rapid ceasefire, ending a decade of grinding war with no clear victor.
blurbs.Emergency_Civilian_Evacuation_from_the_B: Civilian populations are evacuated from the most contested Belt claims as fighting intensifies.
blurbs.Emergency_Debris_Salvage_Mission: A desperate attempt to clear a navigable corridor through the debris field meets only limited success.
blurbs.Emergency_Tether_Standard_Adopted: A shared safety standard for emergency tethering is adopted after a string of fatal accidents across independent claims.
blurbs.Emotional-Blunting_Protocols_Introduced: Corporate security forces introduce crude emotional-suppression protocols for interfaced pilots, the ugly beginning of a two-century-long lineage.
blurbs.Enceladus_Scientific_Claims_Dispute: A dispute breaks out over competing scientific and extraction claims on Enceladus, echoing Europa's earlier tension.
blurbs.Enceladus_Subsurface-Ocean_Tension: Enceladus's own subsurface ocean becomes a permanent minor flashpoint, following Europa's precedent.
blurbs.Equatorial_Launch_Rights_Dispute: The first serious dispute over equatorial basing rights breaks out as blocs scout elevator anchor sites.
blurbs.Europa_Planetary-Protection_Debate: Discovery of Europa's subsurface ocean sparks a never-fully-resolved debate over drilling restrictions.
blurbs.Europa_Quarantine_Zone_Established: A treaty-restricted quarantine zone is established around Europa, permanently limiting but not eliminating drilling activity.
blurbs.European_Coal_and_Steel_Discussions_Open: France, Britain, and Germany open talks on integrating heavy industry, a foundation stone for later Atlantic-Continental cooperation.
blurbs.Field-Repairable_Tech_Becomes_Doctrine: Postwar reconstruction pragmatism hardens into standing engineering doctrine: rugged, standardised, maintainable over clever and fragile.
blurbs.Fighting_Concentrates_in_the_Belt: The bulk of open combat concentrates in the Belt and cislunar space as Earth tries to enforce its blockade.
blurbs.First_Autonomous_Elevator_Climbers_Certi: Automated climber vehicles pass safety certification, a critical engineering milestone for cargo throughput.
blurbs.First_Autonomous_Neptune_Prospector: The first fully autonomous prospecting craft reaches Neptune, testing resource-detection technology at unprecedented range.
blurbs.First_Battlefield_Neural_Feedback_Casual: The first documented casualties from neural feedback overload expose the raw cost of unrefined interface technology.
blurbs.First_Battlefield_Use_of_Recon_Satellite: Reconnaissance satellites see real combat use for the first time, changing how both sides plan offensives.
blurbs.First_Beltwide_Labour_Strike: Workers across multiple Belt operations coordinate the first Belt-wide strike action.
blurbs.First_Belt_Insurance_Consortium_Fails: A major Belt shipping insurance consortium collapses under mounting geopolitical risk premiums.
blurbs.First_Born-on-the-Belt_Generation_Regist: The first generation born and raised in the Belt begins registering for its own recognised citizenship status.
blurbs.First_Child_Born_After_Extended_Artifici: A closely watched medical trial testing extended spin-gravity conditions during pregnancy concludes with a healthy birth, easing fears about long-term off-world settlement.
blurbs.First_Chinese_Nuclear_Alert: China raises its forces to alert status amid war jitters, a reminder that reactor-derived weapons science is now within reach of multiple powers.
blurbs.First_Civilian_Nuclear_Reactor_Demonstra: A working civilian reactor is unveiled to public fanfare, framed as the atom serving progress rather than war.
blurbs.First_Closed-Cycle_Deep-System_Habitat: The first habitat designed for fully closed-cycle operation at extreme distance from the sun is completed.
blurbs.First_Commercial_Asteroid_Prospecting_Sw: A swarm of small robotic prospectors begins surveying the Belt for the first commercially viable claims.
blurbs.First_Commercial_Elevator_Cargo_Contract: The first commercial cargo-leasing contract is signed ahead of the Ecuador elevator's opening, testing the chartered-operator model.
blurbs.First_Continental_Tracking_Network_Opens: The Compact stands up its first satellite tracking stations across Britain, France, and Germany.
blurbs.First_Crewed_Outer-System_Missions: The first crewed missions push past Saturn, an early-stage and unresolved rush rather than an extension of settled Jovian hierarchy.
blurbs.First_Crewed_Venus_Flights: The US flies the first short-duration crewed mission into Venus's cloud layer, PTB Aeromax running the habitat engineering under charter.
blurbs.First_Daughter_Colony_Requests_Independe: An outer-system daughter colony formally requests independent taxation authority, an early assertion of self-governance.
blurbs.First_Elevator_Cable_Sabotage_Confirmed: Investigators confirm a first act of sabotage against an elevator cable, an early sign of the Coalition's long-planned strike.
blurbs.First_Full-Length_Elevator_Material_Test: A full-scale cable material test succeeds, proving the concept is engineering rather than fantasy.
blurbs.First_Independent_Belt_Habitat_Charter: The first fully independent, non-major-backed habitat charter is granted in the Belt.
blurbs.First_Inter-Base_Lunar_Emergency_Rescue: Rival lunar bases cooperate for the first time on a life-or-death rescue, briefly setting rivalry aside.
blurbs.First_Interplanetary_Labour_Federation_C: Mars labour organisers convene the first cross-settlement federation congress, a precursor to the coming uprising.
blurbs.First_Io_Maintenance_Robots_Lost_to_Radi: Even hardened maintenance robots start failing under Io's radiation, underscoring just how unforgiving the moon is.
blurbs.First_Joint_Orbital_Debris_Treaty: Major spacefaring powers sign an early agreement on managing orbital debris, a warning nobody yet takes seriously enough.
blurbs.First_Large-Scale_Enclosed_Habitats_on_M: Habitat engineering matures enough for comfortable large-scale enclosed environments, the beginning of Mars's bifurcation.
blurbs.First_Large_Fragment-Tracking_Network_In: A dedicated debris-tracking network goes up, the direct ancestor of the sensor industry that later becomes LIN Opticene.
blurbs.First_Long-Duration_Orbital_Workshop: An early crewed orbital workshop tests extended-duration life support ahead of the coming station era.
blurbs.First_Man_in_Space: A Soviet cosmonaut becomes the first human in orbit, the USSR's resource edge putting them ahead again.
blurbs.First_Mars_Labour_Tribunal_Opens: The first formal tribunal to hear worker grievances against a chartered operator convenes, with limited practical teeth.
blurbs.First_Mars_Teleoperated_Excavation_Crew: Remote-piloted excavation equipment begins preparatory site work on Mars ahead of crewed landings.
blurbs.First_Neural-Interface_Mech_Piloting: Chartered security forces field the first direct nerve-interface mech pilots, solving the problem of fast local command without AI.
blurbs.First_Off-World_Reparations_Tribunal: A tribunal convenes to settle reparations claims from a decade of off-world war, with mixed and unsatisfying results.
blurbs.First_Permanent_Lunar_Construction_Crew: A permanent construction crew begins work on the Moon ahead of the first true lunar bases.
blurbs.First_Permanent_Mars_Settlements: Soviet, US, and Compact settlements all establish permanent surface presence, each carrying its sponsor's ideology from day one.
blurbs.First_Permanent_Saturn_Relay: A permanent communications relay is established at Saturn, extending infrastructure reach beyond Jupiter for the first time.
blurbs.First_Private_Cislunar_Settlement_Charte: The first fully private settlement charter is issued in cislunar space, a preview of the governance model soon exported to Mars.
blurbs.First_Saturnine_Long-Haul_Freight_Treaty: Saturn system operators agree on shared long-haul freight terms as traffic between Jupiter and Saturn grows routine.
blurbs.First_Secure_Laser_Relay_Between_Earth_a: A hardened, encrypted laser relay link goes online between Earth and Mars just before the crisis that will test it.
blurbs.First_Self-Repairing_Mars_Probe: A robotic Mars probe demonstrates field-repair capability, an early proving point for the coming crewed missions.
blurbs.First_Spacewalks_and_Docking_Tests: All three major programmes conduct spacewalk and orbital docking demonstrations within months of each other.
blurbs.First_Uranian_Relay_Buoy_Deployed: A first communications relay buoy is deployed near Uranus ahead of any serious survey presence.
blurbs.First_Weather_Satellite_Forecasts_Issued: Orbital weather satellites begin feeding practical forecasts, one of the space race's first everyday civilian dividends.
blurbs.Formation_of_the_Oceanic_Partnership: Australia and New Zealand formalise a joint venture drawing on their untouched postwar mineral and industrial wealth to enter the elevator race.
blurbs.Founding_of_Han-Mueller_Biogenics: A German medical technology firm and an American bioscience contractor merge, consolidating the war's crude nerve-interface work into a single company.
blurbs.Founding_of_NASA: The United States establishes a civilian space agency in response to the Sputnik shock, leaning heavily on private contractors from the outset.
blurbs.Founding_of_Novagen: Agricultural-engineering contractors with decades of closed-loop food production experience consolidate into Novagen.
blurbs.Founding_of_PTB_Aeromax: An American atmospheric-engineering contractor is chartered, the ancestor of the eventual Jovian corporate major.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_Compact_Lunar_Base: The Compact founds its own lunar base under a joint multinational authority, technocratic and consensus-driven.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_Compagnie_Spatiale_Conti: Britain, France, and Germany pool their rocketry programmes into a joint continental space effort—the Compact.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_Free_Belt_Company: Spanish anarchist-descended cooperativists, with quiet state permission, found a worker-owned, consensus-governed extraction venture.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_Jovian_Coalition: The four majors and Ganymede's administration formalise a standing treaty and arbitration body for the Jovian system.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_Saturnine_Compact: Saturn's sprawling, multi-stakeholder colony network formalises its own looser, more multilateral treaty body.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_Soviet_Lunar_Base: The USSR establishes its first permanent lunar base, collectivist and state-planned from day one.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_Soviet_State_Mining_Coll: The USSR extends direct state administration into the Belt, an alternative to the majors' corporate charter model.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_State_Committee_for_Cosm: The USSR consolidates its space effort under a single, well-resourced, centrally directed body.
blurbs.Founding_of_the_US_Lunar_Base: The US establishes its own lunar base, contractor-run from the outset even under nominal state ownership.
blurbs.Franco-German_Industrial_Accord: France and Germany sign an industrial cooperation agreement, an early sign of the security relationship still to come.
blurbs.Franco-German_Normalisation_Talks_Open: France and Germany open cautious talks on trade and border normalisation, the first step toward an armed but lasting peace.
blurbs.Free_Belt_Courts_Recognised_by_Three_Ear: Three Earth governments extend formal legal recognition to the Free Belt Company's own consensus courts, a small but real diplomatic milestone.
blurbs.French_Arms_Shipments_Resume: France quietly restarts arms shipments to the Republican government as the Nationalist collapse accelerates, betting on the winning side.
blurbs.Gabon-Congo_Elevator_Rivalry_Simmers: The Compact- and Soviet-backed elevator sites in Central Africa settle into a decades-long low-grade proxy tension.
blurbs.Ganymede_Becomes_the_Jovian_Capital: Partial magnetospheric shielding makes Ganymede the natural seat of Jovian administration and heavy industry.
blurbs.Ganymede_Ice_Port_Opens: An ice-processing port opens on Ganymede, the first real permanent infrastructure in the Jovian system.
blurbs.Germanys_Conservative_Turn: Germany settles into a conservative, authoritarian post-Nazi order, democratic in form but dominated by its old military elite.
blurbs.Germanys_Contested_Alliance_Status: Whether Germany should be folded into a formal Western collective defence structure remains a live, unresolved political fight.
blurbs.Germany_Joins_the_Allied_War_Effort: The war finally settles Germany's long-contested alliance question, folding it into the Atlantic-Continental war effort by necessity.
blurbs.German_Ammunition_Shortages_Become_Publi: Leaked logistics reports reveal the Wehrmacht is running short of matériel far earlier than planned, feeding officer corps doubts about the war.
blurbs.German_Constitutional_Settlement_Announc: Germany's post-coup government announces a new constitutional order, formally ending the Nazi state while preserving much of its conservative military establishment.
blurbs.German_Expeditionary_Corps_Forms: Germany fields its first postwar expeditionary military formation in support of the wider Allied effort.
blurbs.German_Heavy_Launch_Programme_Restarts: Germany's rocketry sector resumes serious heavy-lift work after the war years diverted it to military production.
blurbs.German_Invasion_of_Czechoslovakia: German forces cross the Czechoslovak border, opening full-scale war in Central Europe.
blurbs.German_Rocket_Research_Service_Establish: Germany formalises its rocketry institutions, keeping its veteran engineering corps working at home under the new republic.
blurbs.Hitler_Is_Placed_Under_Army_Guard: Wehrmacht leadership, convinced the war is unwinnable, moves to isolate Hitler ahead of a full takeover of government.
blurbs.Hohmann_Transfer_Convoy_Doctrine_Publish: Military planners formalise doctrine built entirely around the rhythm of transfer windows rather than continuous campaigning.
blurbs.Hohmann_Windows_Dictate_Strategy: Both sides now plan years in advance around transfer windows, unable to redirect fleets once they're committed.
blurbs.Home_Islands_Evacuation_Plans_Leak: Details of Japanese civil-defence evacuation plans leak abroad, signalling how seriously Tokyo is bracing for invasion.
blurbs.Human-in-the-Loop_Doctrine_Adopted: Every major bloc converges on doctrine requiring humans deep in any decision loop touching weapons or reactors.
blurbs.Indochina_War_Continues: France's colonial war against Vietnamese independence forces grinds on, backed by a metropole still flush with postwar strength.
blurbs.International_Elevator_Standards_Commiss: With LEO poisoned for a generation, a commission convenes to set shared technical standards for the coming elevator race.
blurbs.Io_Extraction_Stays_Automated: Io's brutal radiation environment forces extraction operations to stay heavily automated and remote-piloted rather than crewed.
blurbs.Italian_Monarchy_Abolition_Referendum: Italians vote on the future of the monarchy amid the regime's uneasy liberalisation.
blurbs.Italys_Fractured_Liberalisation: Italy's fascist apparatus begins negotiating its own survival inside an opening multi-party system, a bumpy rather than clean transition.
blurbs.Italy_Suspends_Major_Reinforcements_to_S: With the Spanish cause lost, Mussolini quietly winds down Italian military commitments there to save face.
blurbs.Japanese_Refining_Consortium_Faces_Antit: The Japanese refining consortium's dominance over specialist component manufacturing draws its first serious antitrust scrutiny.
blurbs.Japanese_Southern_Strategy_Debated_in_To: Japanese military leadership debates how far to press its offensive into Southeast Asia and the wider Pacific.
blurbs.Japans_Occupation_Formally_Ends: Joint occupation of Japan formally concludes, freeing it to operate as a fully independent non-aligned industrial power.
blurbs.Japans_Quiet_Industrial_Rise: Neutral throughout the war and rebuilding uninterrupted for over a decade, Japan emerges as a serious non-aligned industrial power.
blurbs.Jovian_Coalition_Becomes_a_Military_Alli: The seizure unites the rival majors into a military alliance for the first time in the Coalition's history.
blurbs.Jovian_Coalition_Election_Creates_Civili: The emerging Jovian Coalition holds its first election, creating a civilian secretariat to handle day-to-day arbitration.
blurbs.Jovian_Convoy_Captains_Refuse_Earth_Insp: Jovian shipping captains begin openly refusing Earth-mandated inspections, an early act of defiance ahead of open conflict.
blurbs.Jovian_Demobilisation_Begins: The Jovian Coalition begins standing down its wartime military footing, though its security doctrine never fully returns to peacetime norms.
blurbs.Jovian_Embargo_Begins: The Jovian Coalition responds to the asset seizures with a full resource embargo against Earth.
blurbs.Jovian_Mining_Leagues_Establish_Joint_De: The four majors begin coordinating joint defence patrols across Jovian and Belt shipping lanes.
blurbs.Jovian_Probe_Convoy_Arrives_at_Jupiter: A robotic probe convoy arrives at Jupiter, beginning the systematic survey ahead of crewed settlement.
blurbs.Kessler_Cascade_Cripples_Low_Earth_Orbit: Low Earth orbit becomes functionally unusable in a permanent debris cascade, the era's single defining trauma.
blurbs.Kessler_Extraction_Default_Triggers_Asse: An underfunded independent prospector defaults on its financing, triggering a wave of creditor asset seizures.
blurbs.Korean_Neutrality_Conference_Proposed: Great powers float the idea of a neutral, unified Korea as postwar occupation zones harden into rival spheres.
blurbs.Kuiper_Transit_Insurance_Becomes_a_Major: Underwriting the risk of Kuiper Belt transit becomes a fast-growing industry in its own right.
blurbs.Light-Lag_Stalemate: The war settles into long silences punctuated by rare engagements, defined entirely by Earth-Mars communications delay.
blurbs.LIN_Opticene_Incorporated: The debris-tracking and sensor lineage stretching back to the Orbital War formally incorporates as LIN Opticene.
blurbs.Lunar_Communications_Standard_Agreed: The three lunar-bound programmes agree on shared communications protocols to avoid interference as landings approach.
blurbs.Lunar_Prospecting_Survey_Begins: Robotic survey missions begin mapping viable lunar base sites for the coming permanent settlements.
blurbs.Mars-born_Population_Becomes_Politically: The first generation born on Mars reaches numbers large enough to demand real political representation.
blurbs.Mars_Habitat_Power_Rationing_Crisis: A reactor shortfall forces power rationing across several settlements, straining relations between operators and workers.
blurbs.Mars_Labour_Concessions_Won: After a decade of grinding war, Mars workers win real contract reform and, in places, outright settlement independence.
blurbs.Mars_Labour_Uprising: Decades of calcified contract-labour abuse erupt into open uprising on a major American-chartered settlement.
blurbs.Mars_Landing_Pad_Network_Begins: Construction begins on a shared network of landing infrastructure across candidate Mars settlement sites.
blurbs.Mars_Port_Authority_Declares_Emergency: Rising labour unrest prompts an emergency declaration at a major Mars port, the first sign of the coming uprising.
blurbs.Mars_Property_Bubble_Peaks: Speculative interest in Mars real estate peaks well ahead of the actual comfort or infrastructure to support wealthy transplants.
blurbs.Mars_Sample_Return_Quarantine_Accord: Major powers agree on quarantine protocols for returned Mars samples ahead of the crewed race.
blurbs.Mars_Worker_Rotation_Limits_Introduced: Limits on how long infrastructure workers can be kept on-site are introduced, an early and soon-eroded labour protection.
blurbs.Martian_Ice_Claims_Trigger_Legal_Dispute: Overlapping claims to accessible subsurface ice deposits produce the settlements' first serious legal dispute.
blurbs.Martian_Reconstruction_Authority_Establi: A joint authority is set up to plan for rebuilding once the fighting eventually stops.
blurbs.Multi-Year_Labour_Contracts_Spread: Long-term contract labour spreads beyond the US model into settlements run by blocs that wouldn't frame it that way ideologically.
blurbs.Multilateral_Arms-Control_Treaty: The US, UK, France, Germany, USSR, and China sign a reliable, albeit messy, multilateral framework born from shared postwar horror.
blurbs.Neural-Interface_Security_Goes_Corporate: Transorbital War-era mech and interface doctrine never demobilises; it becomes standard corporate security practice across the Belt.
blurbs.Nuclear_and_Rocketry_Research_Goes_Publi: Reactor physics matures as a civil, rocketry-driven field, pursued openly as prestige science rather than secret weapons work.
blurbs.Nuclear_Strike_on_Nanning: The first-ever use of a nuclear weapon, born from decades of civil reactor and rocketry research, lands on a mobilised target near Nanning.
blurbs.Oceanic_Insurance_Pool_Established: The Oceanic Partnership sets up a shared insurance pool to underwrite the financial risk of elevator construction.
blurbs.Oceanic_Partnership_Secures_Site_in_Kiri: The Oceanic Partnership finalises a low-friction basing agreement with Kiribati for its own elevator project.
blurbs.Off-World_Citizenship_Petition_Reaches_E: Mars-born residents petition Earth courts for recognised citizenship rights, a legal fight that goes nowhere fast.
blurbs.Orbital_Interception_Incident: A further intercept adds to the growing debris field, accelerating the cascade nobody planned but nobody can stop.
blurbs.Outer-System_Labour_Charter_Adopted: A labour charter is adopted for outer-system operations, an early attempt to avoid repeating the Belt's brutal early decades.
blurbs.Outer-System_Navigation_Standard_Adopted: A shared navigation standard is adopted for the outer system before any single power can dominate its layout.
blurbs.Pan-African_Elevator_Infrastructure_Conf: Newly independent equatorial African states convene to negotiate collectively with the powers courting elevator basing rights.
blurbs.Permanent_Aerostat_Cities_Rise_on_Venus: The first permanent floating cities appear in the Venusian cloud layer, with low but exceptionally wealthy populations.
blurbs.Polish_Constitution_Reaffirmed: Poland reaffirms its independent constitutional order, resisting pressure from both German and Soviet spheres of influence.
blurbs.Post-Landing_Lunar_Science_Treaty: The landed powers sign a framework for shared lunar scientific access, an early gesture of restraint amid the ongoing rivalry.
blurbs.Postwar_Elevator_Insurance_Authority_Cre: A new authority is established to underwrite and protect the two surviving elevators, now understood as truly irreplaceable.
blurbs.Postwar_Generation_Ages_Out_of_Leadershi: The generation that built the arms-control and human-in-the-loop doctrines begins leaving power, their caution turning into inherited rule rather than lived memory.
blurbs.Prague_Mobilisation_Crisis: Czechoslovakia mobilises in response to Soviet pressure, echoing the crisis that started the whole conflict decades earlier.
blurbs.Prague_Security_Conference: Czechoslovakia hosts talks on guaranteeing the independence of the new Central European buffer states.
blurbs.Present_Day: The present moment: Earth consolidated and inward-looking, Mars bifurcated, Jupiter established, Saturn sprawling, and the outer system wide open.
blurbs.Radiation_Shielding_Prototypes: First viable deep-space radiation shielding designs are tested, essential for a months-long Mars transit.
blurbs.Rebels_Seize_Mars_Infrastructure: Striking workers seize control of critical life-support and power infrastructure, turning a strike into open rebellion.
blurbs.Reconnaissance_Satellites_Begin_Continuo: Orbital surveillance becomes a permanent, continuous feature of the war rather than an occasional asset.
blurbs.Republican_Victory_in_Spain: Francoist resistance collapses; Republican Spain survives as an independent, Soviet-friendly but non-aligned socialist state.
blurbs.Republican_Victory_Parades_in_Madrid: Madrid celebrates the war's end with parades that become the founding iconography of the new Spanish state.
blurbs.Ring_Material_Prospectors_Organise: Early prospectors working Saturn's rings begin organising ahead of the coming ring rush.
blurbs.Robotic_Survey_of_Jupiter: Full robotic surveying of Jupiter's moons and atmosphere gets underway, scaling PTB Aeromax's Venus template for a much harsher environment.
blurbs.Robotic_Survey_of_the_Kuiper_Belt: Survey missions push out into the Kuiper Belt, the vast, barely-mapped edge of the solar system's next frontier.
blurbs.Robotic_Survey_of_Uranus_and_Neptune: Robotic survey missions begin systematically mapping Uranus and Neptune, echoing every prior frontier's opening beat.
blurbs.Saturnine_Compact_Fleet_Declares_Neutral: The newly formed Saturnine Compact's fleet declares strict neutrality in any future Earth-Jovian disputes.
blurbs.Second_Generation_Soviet_Missiles_Reveal: The USSR unveils a new missile generation, underscoring its deep resource advantage over a Western Europe still building strength.
blurbs.Shanghai_Talks_Collapse: Last-ditch diplomacy to de-escalate the Indochina crisis breaks down in Shanghai.
blurbs.Simultaneous_Sputnik_Launches: The Soviet Union puts the first satellite into orbit, triggering panic in Washington and the Compact capitals alike.
blurbs.Six_National_Elevator_Programmes_Launch: The US, USSR, the Compact, China, and the Oceanic Partnership all formally commit to building their own space elevators.
blurbs.SovietAmerican_Korea_Boundary_Discussion: Washington and Moscow begin haggling over occupation zones in Korea as Soviet forces advance faster than expected.
blurbs.Soviets_Secure_Elevator_Site_in_the_Cong: The USSR secures a basing deal with a Soviet-aligned government in the neighbouring former Belgian Congo territory, setting up a century of rivalry with the Compact's Gabon site.
blurbs.Soviet_and_Japanese_Convoy_Dispute: A shipping-lane dispute between the Soviet collective and a Japanese refining consortium tests the Belt's still-informal traffic norms.
blurbs.Soviet_and_Oceanic_Elevators_Become_Chok: Spared deliberately during the strikes, the Soviet and Oceanic elevators become the two most important chokepoints on Earth overnight.
blurbs.Soviet_Buffer-State_Doctrine_Published: Moscow lays out its formal policy toward the independent buffer states, stopping short of claiming them outright.
blurbs.Soviet_Crewed_Landing_on_Mars: A Soviet crew becomes the first to land on Mars, following the same resource-depth pattern that won them the Moon.
blurbs.Soviet_Elevator_Consortium_Nationalised: Moscow brings its elevator effort fully under state control, rejecting the chartered-operator model taking hold in the West.
blurbs.Soviet_Emergency_Airlift_to_Indochina: Moscow airlifts material aid directly into the widening Indochina conflict, confirming the war has outgrown its colonial origins.
blurbs.Soviet_Forces_Enter_Korea: Soviet troops advance into the Korean peninsula, extending the new front deeper into Japanese-held territory.
blurbs.Soviet_Heavy-Lift_Engine_Accident: A test-stand explosion sets back the Soviet heavy-lift programme, a rare stumble in an otherwise well-resourced effort.
blurbs.Soviet_Lunar_Mining_Charter: Moscow issues its own state mining charter for lunar resource extraction, keeping the effort centrally controlled.
blurbs.Soviet_Manchurian_Offensive: A powerful Red Army pushes hard into Japanese-held Manchuria, opening a major second front against Japan.
blurbs.Soviet_Moon_Landing: A Soviet crew becomes the first to land on the Moon, drawing on the USSR's deepest resource lead yet.
blurbs.Soviet_Pressure_on_the_Buffer_States: Reading Western commitment in Asia as overextension, the USSR moves to pressure Poland and Czechoslovakia, opening the war's European theatre.
blurbs.Soviet_Union_Backs_the_Mars_Rebels: Moscow begins quietly supplying the Mars rebels, turning a local labour crisis into an interplanetary confrontation.
blurbs.Space_Programmes_Resume: All three major space programmes slow-restart, publicly framed as symbols of peace and recovery.
blurbs.Spains_Socialist_Reconstruction: Spain begins rebuilding as a socialist-neutral state with strong Soviet ties, its economy and institutions remade from the ground up.
blurbs.Spain_Europes_Socialist_State: Spain consolidates as Europe's major independent socialist state, a magnet for the international left.
blurbs.Spanish_Agricultural_Mechanisation_Plan: Spain's government rolls out a state-backed plan to mechanise agriculture as part of its ongoing socialist reconstruction.
blurbs.Spanish_Cooperative_Charter_Adopted: Spain formalises legal protections for worker cooperatives, an attempt to bridge state socialism and its restless anarchist factions.
blurbs.Spanish_Reconstruction_Congress_Meets_in: Republican Spain convenes a national congress to plan postwar reconstruction and the shape of its new socialist state.
blurbs.Strategic_Bombing_of_Japan: Sustained conventional bombing campaigns against Japanese cities begin, part of a mounting effort to force Tokyo's surrender.
blurbs.Sudeten_Crisis: Hitler demands the Sudetenland; Czechoslovakia, France, and Britain refuse to concede, and the crisis tips toward open war.
blurbs.Suez_Crisis: Backed by a still-formidable postwar military posture, Britain and France hold the Suez Canal against Egyptian and international pressure alike.
blurbs.System_Census_Begins: A first attempt at a solar-system-wide population census gets underway, an ambitious and only partially successful undertaking.
blurbs.Tarawa_Veterans_Form_the_First_Pacific_M: Survivors of Tarawa's landings form a dedicated amphibious brigade, institutionalising the war's hard-won assault doctrine.
blurbs.The_Anschluss: Germany annexes Austria unopposed; Britain and France protest formally but take no action.
blurbs.The_Compact_Reaches_Lunar_Orbit: The Compact's own crewed lunar mission arrives, closing the loop on a race nobody won outright.
blurbs.The_Orbital_War_Begins: Use-it-or-lose-it logic spirals the ASAT exchange into a full engagement, fought entirely in orbit rather than on the ground.
blurbs.Titan_Becomes_Saturns_Hub: Titan's thick atmosphere and hydrocarbon industry make it Saturn's administrative hub, with a character all its own.
blurbs.Titan_Methane_Shipping_Route_Surveyed: Surveyors chart Titan's hydrocarbon lakes as a future industrial feedstock ahead of Saturn's own colonisation.
blurbs.Trench_Deadlock: Both theatres settle into a grinding, attritional stalemate, years of mobilised armies gaining almost no ground.
blurbs.United_States_Enters_the_War: The United States formally joins the conflict, turning a colonial war into the Second Pacific War proper.
blurbs.USJapanese_Oil_Talks_Collapse: Last diplomatic efforts to resolve the Pacific oil embargo dispute fail, cementing the war's economic dimension.
blurbs.US_and_Compact_Reach_Orbit: Both the US and the Compact put their own crewed missions into orbit within a year of the Soviet first, setting the era's pattern: first, but never alone.
blurbs.US_Carrier_Groups_Enter_the_South_China_: American naval power deploys into the theatre, signalling the war's shift from a regional to a global confrontation.
blurbs.US_Crewed_Landing_on_Mars: The US lands its own crew on Mars within the decade, holding the pattern of no lasting solo prestige.
blurbs.US_Elevator_Traffic_Doubles: Cargo and passenger throughput on the Ecuador elevator doubles within its first two years, validating the economics.
blurbs.US_Moon_Landing: American astronauts land within a year of the Soviets, denying Moscow any lasting claim to sole prestige.
blurbs.US_Secures_Elevator_Site_in_Ecuador: Washington negotiates equatorial basing rights in Ecuador, its flagship elevator project's future anchor site.
blurbs.US_Seizes_Big_Four_Assets_on_Earth: The US freezes and seizes Big Four assets still nominally on Earth, treating a century of corporate sovereignty as a revocable fiction.
blurbs.US_Space_Elevator_Opens_in_Ecuador: The US elevator becomes the first fully operational, heavily publicised as proof the whole approach works.
blurbs.Venus_Aerostat_Accident_Kills_Seventeen: A structural failure in an early Venus habitat kills seventeen, a sobering check on the young aerostat programme.
blurbs.Venus_Atmospheric_Metals_Industry_Begins: Venus stations begin harvesting trace metals and feedstock from the cloud deck, giving the outpost its first real economic export.
blurbs.Veterans_Housing_Crisis_Becomes_a_Politi: A decade of total war leaves veterans facing a severe housing shortage, becoming a defining postwar political fight.
blurbs.Vienna_Security_Talks_End_Without_Agreem: Talks meant to settle Central European security arrangements collapse, leaving Germany's alliance status unresolved.
blurbs.Water-Ice_Claim_Rush_Begins: A rush on water-ice-bearing bodies breaks out as extraction operations race to secure the most valuable claims first.
blurbs.Western_Front_Stalemate: German offensives stall against Czechoslovak resistance while French pressure builds from the west.
blurbs.Winter_Offensive_Fails_at_Nanning: A major push near Nanning collapses into the same attritional deadlock as the rest of the war, setting the stage for the conflict's endgame.
